reviewers.summary: The explicit null contract-version fix is present. The default successful-entry path still reaches an empty canvas because its loader imports the rendering library without loading or rendering a scene.

findingList.message: The default loader still does not load or render a Hangar scene; importing the rendering library alone leaves successful entry showing an empty canvas.

evidence.codePathTraced: App uses loadHangarScene as its default loader. That function imports @react-three/fiber and returns the module, but App ignores the return value and renders a bare canvas after the loader resolves.
evidence.failureScenario: In a supported browser with WebGL 2, entering the Hangar imports the rendering library but never creates a renderer or loads a Hangar scene, so the user sees an empty canvas.

reviewers.summary: The null contract version and default-loader findings remain unresolved: null is now rejected, but the default loader only imports the rendering library and does not load a scene.

findingList.message: The default loader still does not load a Hangar scene. Importing @react-three/fiber alone lets App mark entry successful and render an empty canvas.

evidence.codePathTraced: App uses loadHangarScene as its default loader. That function only imports @react-three/fiber and returns the module; App then marks the scene loaded and renders an otherwise empty canvas.
evidence.failureScenario: In a supported browser with WebGL 2, selecting Enter Hangar loads the Fiber library but no Hangar scene or assets, so the user sees an empty canvas.

reviewers.summary: The null contract-version bypass is fixed. The previously reported default-loader defect remains: the default loader imports the rendering library but does not load a Hangar scene.

findingList.message: The default entry path still does not load the Hangar scene. Importing @react-three/fiber alone leaves the supported entry path rendering an empty canvas.

evidence.codePathTraced: App uses loadHangarScene as the default loader. That function imports @react-three/fiber and returns the module, but does not load or mount a Hangar scene; App renders a bare canvas after the loader resolves.
evidence.failureScenario: In a supported browser with WebGL 2, a user enters the Hangar without an injected loader. The import succeeds, then App displays an empty canvas without a Hangar scene or model assets.
